verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents an official hosted MCP server with OAuth. It gives AI assistants error-investigation, project and BadgerQL query capabilities to help investigate production issues. A Faults API also returns a project's list of faults or a single fault, so an agent can pull and triage errors. The product separately supports detailed issue exports to GitHub, GitLab and Jira, which covers filing bugs into a tracker. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that stack traces/backtraces are returned via the API or MCP, ranking of 'top' issues by frequency or impact, documentation that tracker issue creation can be triggered programmatically by an agent via MCP or API, and independent hands-on corroboration of the agent workflow.
